newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan State Oil rises 1.32 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan State Oil rises 1.32 percent.

text.p: The state-run Pakistan State Oil 10-rupee stock rose five rupees, or 1.32 percent, to 385 on Monday on buying by foreign fund managers, dealers said.
"The blue chip is in heavy demand amid overseas investors," dealer Azhar Batla of Taurus Securities said. Some 10,000 shares changed hands in early trading, he said.

The firm has already paid 30 percent interim cash dividend for 1996/97 (July-June). The firm's first half to December 1996 after-tax profits rose 58 percent to 869 million rupees from 548 million in the year-ago period. ($1 = 40.62 rupees) -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
